title: Name the rule
summary: A useful test name says the rule and the situation. Someone should understand a failure without opening every line of code.
introduction: A useful test name says the rule and the situation. Someone should understand a failure without opening every line of code. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A useful test name says the rule and the situation. Someone should understand a failure without opening every line of code.

blocks.title: Name the rule

blocks.text: The printed check is true, and the name explains the empty-name case.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Write a test name for a non-empty name.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Names such as test1 hide the reason for the test.
For more detail later, use this [Unit Testing further reading](https://nodejs.org/api/test.html).
